title: Discovery 3 — the only supported source of a pool_pair value (no credentials)
description: The CRC/CLP corridor opened in mocks/amm/provisioning is ACTIVE. pair_id is taken verbatim from here into every subsequent call.
notes: Gateway: any. Served from the gateway's pair_proposals table with no on-chain RPC. Treat pair_id as an opaque string: five incompatible naming conventions coexist across the delivered artefacts and none is documented as canonical (catalogued in Toolbox/DIVERGENCES.md), and the currency symbols above (W-tCeBM_CRC / W-tCeBM_CLP) are deliberately NOT the components of the pair id — do not try to derive one from the other. Wrapped-object divergence as in mock-amm-hp-02.
